summary: Generation Income Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its operating partnership amended a secured promissory note with Brown Family Enterprises LLC. The October 2, 2026 amendment extends the maturity date of the $5.5 million original-principal note from October 14, 2026 to October 14, 2027, keeps the fixed 9% simple-interest rate payable monthly, and leaves other payment terms unchanged. The holder acknowledged a $300,000 principal payment made July 6, 2026, confirming a $5.2 million balance as of September 28, 2026, and no default exists. The security interest remains in force. This is a routine debt-maturity extension, not a special situation; watch refinancing risk.
